subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• The effects of social media use on adolescent sleep patterns have been extensively documented, but the underlying neural mechanisms remain poorly understood.
• A research team led by Dr. Ronke Omotosho of Stanford University investigated how social media exposure affects brain activity during sleep.
• Omotosho's team recruited 240 teenagers and used neuroimaging technology to monitor brain activity while participants viewed social media content before bedtime.
• Increased social media use was associated with heightened activity in the brain's arousal centers during sleep.
• Teenagers with higher social media exposure may experience disrupted sleep because their brains remain in a more alert state throughout the night.
prompt: The student wants to emphasize the aim of the research study. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: After recruiting 240 teenagers and using neuroimaging technology, researchers found that increased social media use was associated with heightened activity in the brain's arousal centers during sleep.
choices.B: We now know that teenagers with higher social media exposure may experience disrupted sleep because their brains remain in a more alert state throughout the night.
choices.C: Researchers recruited 240 teenagers and used neuroimaging technology to monitor brain activity while participants viewed social media content before bedtime.
choices.D: Researchers wanted to understand how social media exposure affects brain activity during sleep because the neural mechanisms underlying this relationship remain poorly understood.

explanation: Choice D is the best answer. The sentence emphasizes the aim of the research study by highlighting what the researchers conducting the study wanted to understand—specifically, how social media exposure affects brain activity during sleep.
